mechanism: Fenofibrate may increase primaquine levels through CYP450 enzyme inhibition (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C8), potentially elevating risk of hemolytic toxicity, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis (hemoglobinuria, jaundice, dark urine, anemia); consider alternative antimalarial if possible or use lowest primaquine dose with close hematologic monitoring.
